summary: Explorer Piku: Space is an educational digital manga and storytelling project designed to make NASA's historic space missions understandable, memorable, and engaging for children and young audiences.This is significant because its promites scientific literacy , inspires future explorers and makes space science accessible .
details: Firstly it working Piku meets rovers, landers, and helicopters on the Red Planet (sojourner,spirit and opportunity , viking 1 and 2 etc.) Deep space explorers using special hologram glasses, Piku connects with distant spacecraft (Dawn,NEARShowmaker,pioneer 10 11 etc.) Each spacecraft introduces its own mission, launch date, and scientific achievements in simple first-person dialogues, supported by clear info boxes explaining technical terms like landers or the ecliptic plane. This project benefits Breaks down dense engineering details, mission timelines, and astronomical terminology into bite-sized, easy-to-read comic panels.it boosts retention throught visiual storytelling manga .This project intended impact is young audiences (childrens) .This project creative Instead of presenting NASA history through traditional slides or infographics, this project reimagines space exploration as a manga style Creating an original mascot (piku) rooted in real space history (inspired by Ham the chimpanzee) and giving iconic spacecraft distinct personalities allows missions like Sojourner or Kepler to tell their own stories. Even clever storytelling devices—like Piku’s hologram glasses to bridge the distance to deep-space probes—blend scientific accuracy with imaginative visual design.
